root_causes.issue: WP options get/read + delete/update were separate operations, permitting concurrent lease theft or stale index writes between safety check and database mutation.
root_causes.fix: New Index_Atomic_Options uses single SQL UPDATE JOIN conditioned on exact persisted generation lease and expected index; conditional DELETE protects concurrent lock changes. Both start/final state fenced. WordPress caches invalidated on success. No fallback if atomic DB unavailable.
root_causes.remaining: Real WordPress MySQL concurrent processes, object cache and deployment parity unverified.

root_causes.issue: Old File25 File24 adapter reviewed source pin 0be43... was 82 commits behind verified main a5b..., and File25 manifest contract 1.0.0 no longer matched File24 current minimum 1.2.0; missing required inventory fields keep it incomplete/unassessed.
root_causes.fix: Exact File24 SHA a5b... pinned in adapter, declares manifest contract 1.2.0 and mandatory inventory fields. Blank security test timestamp intentionally retains unassessed status until actual evidence; does not invent vendor/secrets/tables.
root_causes.remaining: Live File24 installed artifact and real security/assurance assessment unverified.
